function.name: lightpanda_fetch
function.description: Fetch a URL with Lightpanda's CLI and return the page as markdown, semantic tree, HTML, structured data, or a rendered PNG/PDF file. No server and no setup: the fastest way to read a single page. Waits for load by default; raise wait_until/wait_ms for JS-heavy pages.

dump.description: Output format. 'markdown' (default) is the most token-efficient read; 'semantic_tree_text' is a compact role/name outline; 'structured_data' returns JSON-LD/OpenGraph/meta; 'png' and 'pdf' are saved to a file and the path is returned.

wait_until.description: Load state to wait for. Default 'load'. Use 'domcontentloaded' plus wait_selector for pages whose ads hold 'load' back.

wait_selector.description: Also wait for this CSS selector to appear before dumping.

wait_script.description: Also wait until this JS expression is truthy before dumping.

selector.description: Dump only the first element matching this CSS selector.

strip_mode.description: Tag groups to remove from the dump. 'clutter' keeps only main content.

with_frames.description: Include iframe contents in the dump.

markdown_alternate.description: With dump=markdown, prefer a markdown alternate the page links (rel=alternate type=text/markdown).

obey_robots.description: Honor robots.txt. Defaults to the skill setting (off).

max_bytes.description: Cap on returned content in bytes (default 200000). Truncation is marked explicitly.

timeout.description: Hard timeout for the whole fetch in seconds (default 120).

function.name: lightpanda_read
function.description: Read the page currently loaded in this agent's Lightpanda browsing session, optionally navigating to a URL first. Keeps session state (cookies, form input, current page) across calls, so use it after lightpanda_act.

url.description: Optional absolute http(s) URL to navigate to before reading.

format.description: markdown (default, best for reasoning), tree (semantic outline with node ids), html (raw), links (all links with resolved href), structured_data (JSON-LD/OpenGraph).

selector.description: Scope to the first element matching this CSS selector (markdown/html/tree).

backend_node_id.description: Scope to this node id (from a previous tree/read result).

max_depth.description: With format=tree, limit the depth of the outline.

limit.description: With format=links, return at most this many links.

max_bytes.description: Cap on returned content in bytes (default 200000).

wait_until.description: Navigation wait strategy when url is given (default load).

function.name: lightpanda_act
function.description: Perform one interaction in this agent's browsing session: navigate, click, fill, press a key, select an option, toggle a checkbox, hover, scroll, or wait. Elements are addressed with a plain CSS selector (preferred) or a backend_node_id from a previous read/tree. Returns the page URL, title and HTTP status from Lightpanda.

selector.description: Plain CSS selector of the target (no Playwright prefixes such as text= or role=).

backend_node_id.description: Alternative target id from a previous tree/read result.

value.description: For fill / select_option: the text or option value.

key.description: For press: key name such as Enter, Tab, Escape, a.

checked.description: For set_checked: true to check, false to uncheck.

script.description: For wait_for_script: a JS expression that must become truthy.

state.description: For wait_for_state: load state to wait for.

wait_until.description: For goto: event that completes navigation (default load).

timeout_ms.description: Action timeout in milliseconds (default 10000 for goto, 5000 for waits).

timeout.description: Protocol timeout for the call in seconds (default 45).

function.name: lightpanda_extract
function.description: Extract structured data from the current page (or a URL) using a schema object that maps output field names to CSS-selector specs. Cheaper and more reliable than reading markdown when you know what you want.

schema.description: Mapping of output field -> CSS selector spec, e.g. {"title": "h1", "links": ["a@href"]}. Passed to Lightpanda as a JSON object literal.

url.description: Optional absolute http(s) URL to navigate to first.

save.description: Optional bridge-store key so later lightpanda_mcp evaluate calls can read the result as lp.<name>.

max_bytes.description: Cap on returned content in bytes (default 200000).

function.name: lightpanda_screenshot
function.description: Render the page (or one element) to a PNG file and return its path. Lightpanda renders its computed text layout, not pixel-accurate browser output, so use this for layout/visual checks, not for pixel comparison. The base64 payload never enters the conversation.

url.description: Optional absolute http(s) URL to navigate to first.

full_page.description: Render the whole content height instead of one viewport (default false).

path.description: Optional destination file path. Defaults to the skill cache directory.

function.name: lightpanda_run
function.description: Run a PandaScript — vanilla JavaScript with Lightpanda's native browser primitives (new Page(), page.goto(), page.extract()) — in this agent's session. Deterministic and token-free, ideal for repeating a multi-step extraction. Cookies and storage persist across runs.

path.description: Alternatively, a script file path (relative to the Lightpanda server working directory).

timeout_ms.description: Stop the script after this many milliseconds (default 60000).

max_bytes.description: Cap on returned output in bytes (default 200000).

function.name: lightpanda_mcp
function.description: Raw passthrough to any Lightpanda MCP tool, for capabilities the wrappers do not cover: evaluate (JS in page), interactiveElements, findElement, nodeDetails, detectForms, getCookies, getEnv, consoleLogs, popups, pageTools/callPageTool, download, acceptCookies, login, classify, search, session_new/list/close. Reading: markdown/html/tree/links/structuredData. Acting: goto/click/fill/press/selectOption/setChecked/hover/scroll/waitForSelector/waitForScript/waitForState. Scripting: run/save/evaluate/extract. Image payloads are saved to files and returned as paths.

arguments.description: Arguments for that tool, matching Lightpanda's own schema (see SYSTEM.md for the catalog).

max_bytes.description: Cap on returned text in bytes (default 200000).

function.name: lightpanda_status
function.description: Diagnose the Lightpanda setup: binary path/version/source, whether the MCP server is running (host, port, pid, log path), active browsing sessions, and the current safety settings. Call this first when a Lightpanda tool fails.

function.name: lightpanda_stop
function.description: Stop the auto-started Lightpanda MCP server and drop all browsing sessions, freeing its memory. The next interactive tool call starts a fresh server automatically.
